This M.Cr.C. is filed under Section 528 BNNS by the petitioner/accused seeking quashment of order of District Court case in Crime No.327/2022 dated 20/07/2024 registered at Police Station - Badgonda for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(N), 376(2) (Cha) and 506 IPC.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State submits that investigation is completed and laid charge-sheet.
The learned Magistrate took the congnizance and committed the case to Sessions Court, which was numbered as S.T. No.100/2022, framed the charges and the trial yet to be commenced.
The applicant was arrested and released on bail, subsequently, on the application filed by the prosecution, bail granted to the accused was cancelled and he was sent to jail.
Quashment of the order passed by trial Court for cancellation of bail does not arise.
At the most fresh application may be filed to release the accused on bail, therefore, this application is dismissed at this stage.

(DUPPALA VENKATA RAMANA) JUDGE Aiyer Ram @Ramnarayan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179452573/
